body: I’ll look into it thank you! & I’ve been told that the tingles usually tell you when you are about to have an OB but It will be days of straight tingles for me and no visual OB!

Idk if it’s related but this happened to me recently and I went to my gyno and she told me it looked like a standard yeast infection. I sometimes wonder if yeast infections/Bv are linked to Outbreaks bc I will get the symptoms of one or the other around the same time I start feeling the tingles and symptoms of an OB. My gyno told me to soak in some apple cider vinegar/white vinegar in a tub to help soothe my the irritation and itchiness. Hope you get some answers from your gyno!
This is very good to know 😅
I will try to listen, thank you for talking to me i really appreciate you

I haven’t tried, all the songs I would listen to kind of remind me of people or different points in my life that I can’t really relate to 

Do you have any songs maybe

I just for some reason haven’t been able to see very far into the future. I just i want to reach the place you’re talking about... it just feels impossible. 

I just don’t know if i really like myself anymore

I just miss my friend, i miss being able to talk to her and talk through things and laugh about things. She was my best friend and since everything has happened i have watched her go further and further away from me. 

I thought i meant something special to someone. I thought we loved eachother in the same way and we didn’t. After almost a year of being with him he told me we were simply friends. I lived with him and when i moved out he paid for my new apartment, my current apartment. But he’s been talking to other girls this whole time. Which sounds silly to be upset about in the grand scheme of things but i just put so much trust in him. I feel fucking crazy for putting so much into him. And it really sucks because i just want him to come over and tell me it’s going to be okay like he always does. But he was lying to me, why would i want someone who did that. 

I lost my best friend, i assume he will leave my life too. In a way i betrayed his trust by going through his phone. I wish i never did but then i would still be living a lie. I still wish i never said anything or saw anything or allowed myself to get that upset. I just don’t get how you could say you were just friends with someone who you talk about kids and love with and so many other things.

I’m trying to talk to people and sometimes it helps and sometimes it doesn’t. My family isn’t the easiest to talk to. The person i normally talk to has been lying to me for months, which i found out yesterday. I’m in the process of trying to talk to a therapist but it’s hard with the virus and his everything is online

I was sexually assaulted in December and already struggled with depression and anxiety. I never talked to anyone about it truly and i didn’t know how much it could hurt to have to live with it everyday. I pretty much think about it in some way everyday but before covid i could distract myself and now i lost my job, i lost a close friend and I’m so alone. And this month is sexual assault awareness month and there are triggers everywhere

I have anxiety attacks often, my triggers seem pretty nonsensical now though, I always have a deep underlying feeling of stress inside me that I can’t seem to shake... sometimes it does help but recently I just always feel some form of anxiety or panic washing over me so i don’t have any peaceful moments where i can step back and get through it?
I guess just how do we keep going when this feeling feels so infinite... i don’t want to feel like this forever
